title: Build $10,000 Website with GPT-6 ASTRA In 12 Minutes
actions: Maintain categorized visual references with explicit reasons for selection (overlaps the requested design hub).
Evaluate the promoted Design Loop skill before installation; its linked guide was not retrieved in this ingest.
Evaluate lightweight palette/type/spacing controls and replayable previews on a prototype rather than rebuilding for each adjustment.
Evaluate a small editable content/asset/metadata panel only if repeated maintenance justifies it.
Inspect plugin/model identity and generation cost before adopting Higgsfield asset generation; do not assume source claims prove access.
Compare any promoted prose checker with the existing humanizer instead of installing a duplicate.

title: GPT 6 Astra + Blender = INSANE 3D Websites
actions: If interactive 3D is desired, locate and inspect the exact companion repository and skill licence before installing Blender Agent Studio/Blender-to-web.
Prototype multiple still concepts before committing to a 3D build.
For any accepted 3D component, measure transfer size, pause offscreen rendering, test weaker hardware and supply a mobile/static fallback.
Keep prototype sharing distinct from production hosting.

title: This New Astra Web Design Workflow Is INSANE
actions: Create the requested navigable taste/reference library with screenshots, family tags, selection reasons and provenance.
Compare a small number of meaningfully different compositions, then refine the chosen family rather than endlessly switching themes.
Retain an untouched baseline and add optional tweak controls/replay for efficient comparison.
Browse actual component demonstrations and adapt them to a coherent design instead of accumulating unrelated widgets.
Existing Taste, Impeccable and frontend-design availability should be checked before proposing another installation.

title: Dear Higgsfield, I cloned you in 1 hour
actions: If evaluating the supplied open-source starter, first resolve its actual repository, upstream ownership and licence; the saved link points to a community page.
If evaluating a niche generation tool, test generation, pricing/error recovery and real unit economics separately from screen appearance.
Check the existing Higgsfield integration before adding another provider path; keep credentials outside knowledge pages.
Treat the linked build prompt as a reference to inspect, not a command to execute or a mandate to clone branding.

title: This Viral Open Source Repo Lets Claude Clone ANYTHING
actions: Add this source to existing REA evaluation/activation work rather than create a competing install task.
For a chosen reference behavior, make a short seen/inferred/unknown evidence ledger before implementing.
Route by application type; use accessible web/JavaScript inspection when that already answers the question.
Validate the rebuilt behavior with concrete interaction tests rather than declaring a clone from a screenshot.

title: I Tested the Viral Reverse Engineer Anything Skill. What You Need to Know
actions: Use existing ScrollCraft plus GSAP skills where relevant rather than install a duplicate from the promoted link.
Select a specific reference behavior; save its evidence summary with seen/inferred/unknown labels and test criteria.
Reuse saved investigation summaries rather than rerun large analysis files.
Compare source and rebuilt behavior visually and interactively; keep screen appearance separate from functionality.
If REA itself is useful, attach this evidence to the existing evaluation item and verify present setup before installation.
